'''Flash-freeze units''' were used in [[87-RM Scout Collector]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. It created a cryogenically-controlled [[Hypothermia/Legends|hypothermia]] to freeze captured specimens within a matter of [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|13|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
